## Key Design Elements

### **Left Panel - Conversation List**
- Conversations sorted by most recent message
- Shows: Contact name/group name, phone number, last message preview, timestamp

  - 🔕 Muted conversations (grayed)
  - 📁 Archived conversations (in separate section or filter)
  - ● Blue dot for unread
  - ✓ / ✓✓ Delivery status (sent/delivered/read)
  - 👥 Group indicator with participant count
- Filter dropdown: All, Unread, Groups, Archived

### **Right Panel - Message Thread**
- Header with contact/group info
- Chat bubble layout:
  - Incoming messages: Left-aligned, different color
  - Outgoing messages: Right-aligned
  - Timestamps above/beside messages
  - Delivery status on outgoing
  - Reactions displayed on messages
- Compose area at bottom (simulates sending - creates events)

### **Toolbar**
- New Message button (opens compose dialog)
- Actions on selected conversation: Delete, Archive, Mute, Pin
- Refresh button

### **Status Bar**
- Summary stats: X conversations, Y messages, Z unread
